newsitem.title: GERMANY: World economy seen growing 3.3 percent in 1997.
newsitem.headline: World economy seen growing 3.3 percent in 1997.

text.p: The global economy will expand around a real 3.3 percent this year, boosted above all by fast growth in Asia and Latin America, the Ifo economic research institute said Sunday.
Ifo said a survey of 450 international experts showed the Latin American economies were expected to grow 5.2 percent this year and Asian economies were expected to grow by 4 percent.
Western Europe faced relatively slow economic growth of 2.3 percent while North America was due to expand 2.8 percent, the Munich-based institute said.
During the first quarter of 1997, the survey showed experts were surprised at the strength of the American and British economies and "disappointed" at growth in Europe.
Ifo said firms in Europe and Asia saw good export prospects this year due to the strong dollar.
Although inflation remained low, the survey saw interest rates in several industrialised countries headed higher.
